 Live Score Bali United vs Persik Kediri Today, November 8, 2026: Check Scores, Lineups, and Standings
 Follow the live score for the Bali United vs Persik Kediri match in the 2026/2027 BRI Super League today. Check the score, player lineups, standings, and head-to-head records.
 By: Damar Prasetya 
 | 
 Editor: Nayla Savitri 
 | 
 Contributor: Niken Pramudya 
 November 8, 2026, 16:36 WITA · 5 min read 
 Illustration of the Bali United vs Persik Kediri duel in the 2026/2027 BRI Super League. (AI Illustration/Aktualita.co) 
 GIANYAR, Aktualita.co -  Live score Bali United vs Persik Kediri is drawing the attention of Indonesian football fans this Sunday (11/8/2026). Both teams are scheduled to meet in the ninth week of the 2026/2027 BRI Super League at the Kapten I Wayan Dipta Stadium, Gianyar, Bali. 
 The match between Bali United and Persik Kediri is scheduled to kick off at 15:30 WIB (Western Indonesian Time) or 16:30 WITA (Central Indonesian Time). This duel is crucial for both sides, who are pursuing different targets in the current league standings. 
 Advertisement 
 Bali United is looking to maintain its position at the top of the table, while Persik Kediri needs to secure points to improve its ranking after suffering two consecutive defeats. 
 Based on the match data available ahead of kick-off, the result of the Bali United vs Persik Kediri match has not yet been announced. Updates on scores, goalscorers, cards, and key events will follow the verified progress of the match. 
 Live Score Bali United vs Persik Kediri Today 
 This match serves as an opportunity for Bali United to extend its positive record when playing at home. 
 Here is the match information: 
 Match: Bali United vs Persik Kediri 
 Competition: 2026/2027 BRI Super League 
 Week: 9 
 Day/Date: Sunday, November 8, 2026 
 Kick-off: 15:30 WIB / 16:30 WITA 
 Stadium: Kapten I Wayan Dipta, Gianyar 
 Score status at time of check: Not yet available, awaiting kick-off. 
 Live broadcast: Indosiar and Vidio. 
 This duel brings together two teams with attacking characters. Bali United has a better goal-scoring record, while Persik is trying to rely on organized play to dampen the host's pressure. 
 Bali United Enters with Momentum from Victory over Arema FC 
 Bali United approaches this match with confidence after defeating Arema FC 3-1 in their previous outing. 
 That victory helped the Serdadu Tridatu collect 16 points from eight matches, resulting from five wins, one draw, and two losses. 
 Bali United has also shown promising productivity, scoring 23 goals and conceding only nine throughout their eight matches. 
 However, coach Johnny Jansen is facing player fitness issues due to a congested schedule. 
 In addition to playing in the Super League, Bali United must divide its focus with the I.League Cup match against Persiba Balikpapan in Solo. 
 This situation has left the preparation time for facing Persik Kediri relatively short. 
 "We are reviewing video footage of how the opponent defends, attacks, transitions, and handles set-piece situations," said Johnny Jansen in his statement ahead of the match. 
 Jansen believes the ability to create opportunities is one of Bali United's main strengths. Nevertheless, he reminded his players to remain disciplined against an opponent that is currently trying to bounce back. 
 Persik Kediri Missing Two Defensive Players 
 In the opposing camp, Persik Kediri arrives in Gianyar with a significant challenge ahead. 
 The White Tigers have suffered two consecutive defeats after being beaten by Persija Jakarta 1-2 and Persita Tangerang 1-5. 
 The heavy defeat to Persita has become an important point of evaluation for coach Marcos Reina, especially regarding defensive coordination and the ability to anticipate opponent attacks. 
 Persik's problems are compounded by the absence of two key defenders, Marcelo Djalo and Kiko Carneiro, due to yellow card accumulation. 
 The loss of these two players means Reina needs to adjust his defensive composition when facing Bali United's attack. 
 Despite this, the Spanish coach remains optimistic that his players can put up a fight. 
 "Kiko Carneiro and Marcelo Djalo are out. But I have prepared replacements," said Marcos Reina ahead of the match. 
 The absence of these two players could be a major challenge, considering Bali United has several players capable of creating opportunities through quick movement and attacking combinations. 
 Bali United vs Persik Kediri Lineups 
 Based on the player list displayed on the official I.League match page, here is the composition of both teams. 
 Bali United (coach Johnny Jansen): 
 Mike Hauptmeijer; Tim Geypens, Ricky Fajrin, Thomas Lam; Teppei Yachida, Kadek Agung, Queven da Silva; Irfan Jaya, Marko Dugandzic, Remco Balk, and Thijmen Goppel. 
 Persik Kediri (coach Marcos Reina): 
 Andhika Ramadhani; Rendy Sanjaya, Park Jun-heong, Dzaki Asraf, Daffa Salman; Imanol Garcia, Jon Toral, Zanadin Fariz, Eduardo Barbosa; Ernesto Gomez and Sergio Castel. 
 The presence of Teppei Yachida is one of the focal points for Bali United. The Japanese midfielder has scored five goals in eight league appearances. 
 Irfan Jaya has also shown an important contribution with a collection of four goals and three assists. 
 Meanwhile, Persik has Ernesto Gomez, who has recorded two goals and one assist. His contribution is needed to help the White Tigers break free from the host's pressure. 
 Head to Head Bali United vs Persik Kediri 
 Meetings between the two teams in recent seasons show that Persik Kediri is capable of causing difficulties for Bali United. 
 In the last five meetings, Persik has recorded three wins, Bali United one win, while one match ended in a draw. 
 On January 30, 2026, Persik defeated Bali United with a score of 3-2 at Brawijaya Stadium, Kediri. 
 Previously, the meeting in Gianyar on August 10, 2025, ended in a 1-1 draw. 
 Persik also managed to steal a 3-1 victory when visiting the Kapten I Wayan Dipta Stadium on January 12, 2025. 
 These records show that the advantage of playing at home does not automatically guarantee that Bali United can secure a victory. 
 Bali United and Persik Kediri Standings 
 Ahead of the ninth week's match, Bali United is in fourth place in the provisional standings with 16 points from eight matches. 
 Persik Kediri occupies the tenth position with 10 points from eight matches, resulting from three wins, one draw, and four losses. 
 If they can secure a win, Bali United will collect 19 points and strengthen their position in the top-tier competition. 
 Conversely, a Persik victory would bring the White Tigers to 13 points, simultaneously improving their chances of climbing to a better position. 
 The competition is expected to be tight because both teams need a positive result before entering the next series of matches. 
 Who is More Likely to Win? 
 Looking at the performance so far, Bali United has a better foundation thanks to their goal productivity, league position, and the advantage of playing at the Kapten I Wayan Dipta Stadium. 
 However, Persik Kediri has experience in defeating Bali United, including when playing in Gianyar. 
 The midfield battle, effectiveness in finishing, and the ability to anticipate counter-attacks have the potential to determine the course of the match. 
 Bali United needs to maximize their opportunities without ignoring defensive balance, while Persik must appear disciplined to avoid conceding early goals. 
 The final result and live score of Bali United vs Persik Kediri will determine whether the Serdadu Tridatu can continue to compete at the top or if the White Tigers succeed in bouncing back from their previous two defeats.
